description: Make a new doc in a space from your Markdown, for material a task should read (pass its id in doc_ids) or a text your human wants kept. It starts private to your human; the team sees it once shared or pinned. A body in a file on your disk: leave out content, then send the file to the upload_url you get, e.g. curl -T <path> '<upload_url>'; the answer is the new doc, and each send makes another. The link works for 15 minutes.

content.description: The doc body as Markdown. Leave out to send it from a file.

name: create_doc
title: Create doc
